# The water cycle

A synthetic fixture with **bold**, _italic_ and `code`, and a [link to the kit](https://github.com/Tanno-Finn/vibe-core).

## Steps

1. Evaporation
2. Condensation
   - small droplets
   - clouds
3. Precipitation

### Terms

| Term        | Meaning                 |
| ----------- | ----------------------- |
| Evaporation | Water turns into vapour |
| Runoff      | Water flows back        |

> Water keeps moving between earth, air and sea.
